page.layout: One page of text, one column. Running head at top centre. Catchword at lower right. Fragments at both outer edges are the neighbouring page and are not transcribed.

main_text.p: Ies[?] ad defperationem agebant extrema omnia minantes, non iis duntaxat, qui prima Bel-li Hujus Capita, & Faces fuerant, fed ip-fi Genti Univerfæ, obftinati, omnes fimul, viros, fæminas, infantes, Germen & Radi-cem perdere: nulla eorum ratione habitâ, quæ arguimenta plerumque in Misericor-diam valida, quæque à propriis pectoribus fuggefta fatis audiunt illi Victores, quos non omnis Humanitas deferuit, ne fæviant vi-delicet in Illos, quos è facie miserabili a-gnoscas plus à malis suis propriis, quàm ma-litiâ stimulatos: vel qui sexu aut ætate im-becilli nec contra manum levare, nec inter dexteram & finistram distinguere potuissent. Quo quidem præpostero, & minimè omnium Euangelico zelo illos potius imitantur à Seruatore nostro reprehensos Discipulos, qui, quòd à paucis exclusi aut neglecti fuissent, haud mitius quam Igne cælitus totas Vrbes haufturo, vindicandam hanc Injuriam censuerunt; vel Illos filios Jacob à Patre cum execratione increpitos; cum Illa potius aspera & extrema optarint, queis ad præfractam desperationem redigantur homines, quàm moderata remedia, adhibere, qualia essent, nonnullos in exemplum castigare, alios veniâ supplicantibus ablatâ, armis exuere & in posterum tutos præstare à Gentilium suorum furoribus, qui eodem secum flumine natare recusantes prompti nimis essent submergere.

page.notes: Greek running head: the last letters are hard to read at the scan edge and are marked [?]. "Ies" at the start of the page is a fragment of a word continued from the previous page; the first letter is uncertain. Italic words are as seen in the scan. The catchword "Est" is printed at the lower right. No marginal notes on this page. Printed "Jacob" and "Germen" are copied as the scan shows them.
